description: Closure event referring only generically to 'inbound vessels', no named ship.
subject: Operational Notice - Port of Algeciras
body:
Dear Owners,

The port of Algeciras (ESALG) has suspended operations due to a labor strike. Inbound vessels should expect to be delayed by 20 hours, with berth time updated to 2026-12-01 08:00 UTC.

Regards,
Algeciras Agency
